normative_claims.text: HG-KSEOS is the sole WorkOrder/admission/gate control plane; Hermes is the governed runtime/orchestration plane; Fabric is a contract surface only. Native compiler PASS must precede any product write.

doctor() validates only <root>/schemas, so an installed wheel missing a packaged schema member still reports verdict=PASS for a healthy workspace: the diagnostic the ordinary user reads does not cover the schemas the CLI resolver actually loads.

Both B4 wheel mutations install successfully; the low-level registry API refuses but the CLI surface does not, and B5 truncation surfaces as an interpreter SyntaxError rather than a typed integrity failure.

The R5 owner re-specified the gate as PER_ATOM_BYTES(2000) with the old 343547>20000 FAIL preserved historically; the measurement target and denominator changed, so an anti-dilution oracle is required before the gate can be re-quoted.

The reviewed public tip is r5-s4-packreader 0f06eec96386b7349db8b41ac6cf9c7455d326f1 / tree 1f7564282fd708fab2ddeadbbbe4e424a3c564be; main is still the R3 commit 3aebbbce948871c07b875ab92acf263d298ecf38 and must not be treated as the S4 end state.
The round ceiling is S4_NORMAL_USER_OPERABILITY for an authorized evaluator: never RELEASED, PRODUCTION_VERIFIED, PRE-W3 PASS or a public grant; S5-S8 stay deferred with typed seams.
